subject: Re: Squeeze-window close plan - MSA / DPA / Order Form (eval & evidence windows)
messages:
From: Katie Long <katie.long@everwell.health>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>
Cc: procure_ops@everwell.health
Date: Tue, 11 Aug 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Can we accelerate the contract timeline?

Hi Kimberly / Laura,

Thanks again for the demo last week — team was impressed. We have internal pressure to finish the procurement before the next board meeting (third week of Aug). Is there any realistic way to compress the MSA / DPA / order form path so we can sign by Aug 20?

Key constraints on our side:
- Security evidence needs a 48-hour window for our InfoSec team to validate SOC/attestation items.
- Procurement needs final pricing and reseller/order form by EOD Aug 17 to hit PO cutoffs.
- Legal is short-staffed but can do a focused redline pass if we keep the scope tight.

Can you propose a short MAP (mutual action plan) tying evaluation milestones to contract checkpoints and a fallback if any evidence items take longer?

Appreciate a pragmatic plan — I can bring in j.simonson from procurement if useful.

Thanks,
Katie

---
Katie Long
Senior Program Manager, Strategic Procurement
EverWell Health
From: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.ai>
To: Katie Long <katie.long@everwell.health>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>
Cc: David Kim <david_kim@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 11 Aug 2026 11:04:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Can we accelerate the contract timeline?

Katie —

We can do a compressed, risk-aware plan. Draft below is a 9-business-day "squeeze window" that preserves the minimum evidence checks and builds in two fallbacks. I'll attach the MAP + evidence checklist and a preliminary order form for quick review.

High-level proposed timeline (compressed):
- Aug 11 (today): MAP v3 shared (attached). Confirm stakeholders & final evaluation test cases.
- Aug 12–13: Security sends the minimal evidence bundle (SOC summary + short answers). Redwood prepares evidence guide + demo logs.
- Aug 14: Legal rapid-redline (Redwood shares a tight-scope MSA with highlighted fallbacks).
- Aug 15: Procurement confirms pricing; Redwood shares order form draft and DocuSign flow.
- Aug 16: Joint sign-off on DPA language (we can adopt Redwood standard DPA with only minimal edits).
- Aug 17: Target signature window — preferred.
- Aug 18–20: Fallback window | rolling sign as items clear.

Fallbacks / risk controls:
- If InfoSec requires >48 hours for any item, we propose an evidence escrow: Redwood provides access-limited logs + a 30-day remediation SLA documented in the MAP so procurement can close while technical validation completes.
- If legal redlines exceed the tight-scope, we do a one-item-at-a-time priority list (order form & pricing prioritized first to enable PO issuance).

Immediate asks for your team:
1) Confirm that the procurement cutoff is Aug 17 (Katie / j.simonson).
2) Share the contact who'll do the security validation and their earliest availability (48-hour window start).
3) Share any must-have terms that cannot be deferred to post-signature.

I'll loop David for legal points and attach the MAP/evidence checklist now. If this looks good I'll set up a 15-min standup at 9:30am PT Wed–Fri to keep cadence tight.

Attachments: EverWell_MAP_v3.xlsx, evidence_inventory.pdf

Thanks,
Kimberly Park
Head of Sales Operations
Redwood Inference
From: David Kim <david_kim@redwood.ai>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>
Cc: Katie Long <katie.long@everwell.health>
Date: Tue, 11 Aug 2026 13:22:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Squeeze-window close plan - legal redline and evidence expectations

Kim / Katie —

Quick legal notes to keep the schedule realistic:
- I can do a constrained redline pass in 24 hours if we limit scope to (a) indemnity cap, (b) data processing paragraphs (DPA), and (c) termination on material breach. Anything beyond those will require extra cycles.
- I'll upload a redline-ready MSA with comments (redlines_msa.docx). Please confirm whether your counsel requires specific DPA clauses or whether we can rely on our standard (we have an addendum model for HIPAA/PHI).

Evidence-wise: the evidence_inventory.pdf lists the minimal artifacts we can accept for sign-off. If EverWell can provide the requested SOC snapshot + contact to run a 48-hour check, that should be sufficient to unblock procurement. Otherwise we'll need the escrow approach Kimberly suggested.

If procurement insists on vendor risk scoring by a third party, that will add 3–5 business days — flagging now.

I'll be available 2–4pm PT for an ad-hoc call if you want to walk through the clauses.

-David

David Kim
Senior Counsel, Contracts & Privacy
Redwood Inference
From: Katie Long <katie.long@everwell.health>

Thanks, Kimberly / David.

Confirming: procurement cutoff is Aug 17 EOD for our PO cycle — we need pricing & order form by then. j.simonson is now on the thread for procurement coordination. Our InfoSec lead (tara.nguyen@everwell.health) can run the 48-hour review starting Aug 12 afternoon.

Two quick items from our side:
- We can accept the evidence escrow approach if necessary, provided the logs access is read-only and expires automatically after 30 days.
- Legal will try to keep changes minimal; we'll prioritize order form pricing & DPA scoping (no change to indemnity unless material).

I'll review the attached MAP and evidence checklist this morning and flag any blockers by noon PT.

K
